mapper.sql: r.rule_id, r.rule_name, r.rule_code, r.rule_type, r.cycle_days, r.dept_id, r.enabled, r.description, r.create_by, r.update_by, r.create_time, r.update_time
mapper.select: select r.rule_id, r.rule_name, r.rule_code, r.rule_type, r.cycle_days, r.dept_id, r.enabled, r.description, r.create_by, r.update_by, r.create_time, r.update_time, i.item_id, i.rule_id as ir_rule_id, i.day_index, i.shift_id as i_shift_id, s.shift_id as is_shift_id, s.shift_name, s.shift_code, s.shift_type from sch_shift_rule r left join sch_shift_rule_item i on r.rule_id = i.rule_id left join sch_shift s on i.shift_id = s.shift_id where r.rule_id = #{id} order by i.day_index

select distinct
from sch_shift_rule r inner join sch_user_rule ur on r.rule_id = ur.rule_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and ur.enabled = 1 and r.enabled = 1 order by r.rule_id

select
from sch_shift_rule r where r.dept_id = #{deptId} and r.enabled = 1 order by r.rule_id
